parsed.rationale: All three type-alias-objects — `MaterialBlendModeKey` (MaterialBlendMode.swift:89), `OverlayBlendModeKey` (_Plant_OverlayBlendMode.swift:89), and `PlaybackBlendModeKey` (PlaybackBlendMode.swift:89) — are exact duplicates (shared_field_count=1, differing_slots=null) living in the same `Wallpaper` package. They differ only in name, which encodes the blend-mode domain variant. A single generic `BlendModeKey<Mode>` type parameterised on the mode type would eliminate all three duplicates while preserving type safety for each variant. Because all three files are in the same package, no cross-package dependency changes are required.
